meta_description: If you still have questions about vaccines, you’re not alone. Immunologist and @TEDFellow Kizzmekia Corbett-Helaire (@kizzyphd) — the person who co-developed the first COVID-19 vaccine — not only believes you’re entitled to ask them, but says scientists should learn to answer better. Visit the link in @TED’s bio to watch her full talk on her approach to vaccine inquisitiveness. - 1,806 likes, 308 comments - @ted on October 26, 2026
